name: FILEkavach
description:
FILEkavach is your trusted digital vault for all your important study and personal documents. Keep everything safe, organized, and instantly accessible—anytime, anywhere.

Whether you’re a student saving notes, a professional storing certificates, or simply someone who wants a secure place for personal files, FILEkavach makes file management effortless and reliable.

🔐 Key Features
• Secure Cloud Storage: Upload and store documents with end-to-end encryption.
• Easy Organization: Create folders, tag files, and keep study materials neatly categorized.
• Instant Access: Retrieve any document in seconds with fast search and preview options.
• Offline Availability: Access your most important files even without an internet connection.
• Smart Backup: Never lose your data—automatic backup keeps files protected at all times.
• Multi-Device Sync: Access the same documents from phone, tablet, or web.
• File Sharing: Share selected files safely with classmates or colleagues.
• Clean & Simple Interface: Modern, distraction-free design for easy navigation.

🎓 Perfect For
• Students who want to store notes, assignments, and study resources.
• Teachers and tutors managing class materials.
• Professionals keeping documents like IDs, resumes, and certificates organized.
• Anyone who values privacy and convenience in digital document management.

🛡️ Why FILEkavach?
Your data is your asset. FILEkavach safeguards it with secure encryption, cloud protection, and private access controls. Unlike ordinary storage apps, FILEkavach is built with privacy-first principles—your files stay yours.

🌐 Coming Soon:
• Document scanner with auto-crop and OCR text recognition.
• Multi-layer security with biometric lock and PIN protection.
• Version history and advanced sharing controls.

Take control of your digital documents with confidence. Keep your files safe, organized, and always within reach—only with FILEkavach.

Download now and experience secure, smart document storage designed for students and professionals alike.
summary: Securely store, organize & access all your study and personal documents.
